newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end ahead, target life high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end ahead, target life high.

text.p: 1330 GMT - Austria's ATX index advanced 1.13 percent to 1,241.04 points on Friday, breaching resistance at 1,227 and setting its sights on life high of 1,261.16.
Traders said fresh demand for market heavyweight OMV was behind the rise. Prices were further underpinned by firm overnight close on Wall Street, they added.
* 14 ATX gainers, six losers, one unchanged.
* Top gainer steel firm VA Stahl up 3.41 pct at 515 ats, followed by energy and chemicals group OMV, up 3.25 pct at 1,495.0 ats.
* Insurer EA-Generali biggest decliner, down 1.28 pct at 3,080 ats.
* May ATX contract up 19.3 points at 1,239.9 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 254
